body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose one enemy within 5 units. Until your next turn, the first ally that damages it becomes Rallied.

surges.html: You may suffer -1 Defense until your next turn; if you do, one affected ally becomes Rallied.
One enemy affected by this card suffers -1 Defense against the ally you designate until its next turn.

rider.title: VOW — AUTHORITY
rider.html: Spend this card's Authority when an enemy violates the Vow's declared boundary or target: 1–3 it suffers -1 Defense; 4–5 it becomes Exposed; 6+ it becomes Exposed and burns 1 die.
rider.meta: STORE ONE ROLLED RESULT; THAT RESULT IS REMOVED FROM THIS ACTION
